proof:
change ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ F E : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial, F.Monic → E.Monic → F ∣ M6.Cyclic.modulus N → E ∣ M6.Cyclic.modulus N → (M7.SignatureIdeal.principal N F = M7.SignatureIdeal.principal N E ↔ F = E)
intro N inst F E hFm hEm hF hE
constructor
· intro h
  have hFF : M6.Cyclic.image N F ∈ M7.SignatureIdeal.principal N F :=
    (M7.SignatureIdeal.quotient_membership N F F hF).mpr (dvd_refl F)
  have hEE : M6.Cyclic.image N E ∈ M7.SignatureIdeal.principal N E :=
    (M7.SignatureIdeal.quotient_membership N E E hE).mpr (dvd_refl E)
  have hFE : F ∣ E := by
    apply (M7.SignatureIdeal.quotient_membership N F E hF).mp
    rw [h]
    exact hEE
  have hEF : E ∣ F := by
    apply (M7.SignatureIdeal.quotient_membership N E F hE).mp
    rw [← h]
    exact hFF
  first
  | exact Polynomial.Monic.dvd_antisymm hFm hEm hFE hEF
  | exact Polynomial.dvd_antisymm hFm hEm hFE hEF
· intro h
  subst E
  rfl
